sketchMechanisms: The Maybe monad's bind operator silently propagates Nothing, so once absence enters a chain, every subsequent step yields Nothing without ever being evaluated.
Ruby's frozen? method and freeze: once an object is frozen, any attempt to modify it raises a RuntimeError. The object persists but can never change again.
A sealed trait with a single case object means pattern matching is exhaustive with only one possibility — the compiler knows there is nothing else.
